Side view at the cursor

The array seen from the side, to scale. Mics are shaded by how loud they are right now; the dot is the fitted source position, with its last 2 s as a trail.

Where the sound is along the array, over time

Each row is a mic at its position; shading is its level above its own noise floor. The line is the fitted source position along the array. Drag or click to move the cursor.

Distance from the mic line

How far the source was from the line of mics (a line array can't tell above from below or front from back).
